name: NASA-Grade Deep-Space Navigation Engine (Signature Engineering Database)
tagline: Signature edition: engineering methods, prototype designs, and executable demos for the Deep-Space Navigation Engine tool class.
hero_line: Signature, fact-checked original prototype designs and executable demos for a NASA-grade/DARPA-grade programmer tool class.
about_dl:
<dt>Archive</dt><dd>One of 200 NASA-grade and DARPA-grade programmer-tool databases (item 204): 100 advanced tool classes, each with a public engineering database and a Signature engineering database.</dd>
<dt>Record schema</dt><dd>Every record carries id, title, description, full body, capabilities, a working demonstration program with its node-verified output, provenance, licensing, edition, ladder rank, maturity label, verification status, and generator reference.</dd>
<dt>Generator</dt><dd>Deterministic boundless generator (gen-<slug>.js, dual node+browser); same seed + same topic = same record; hard cap 10^15; generated content marked generated.</dd>
<dt>Database AI</dt><dd>The archive AI is lookup- and Q&A-capable over this database and its generator, and teaches the tool class progressively from simple to god-mode ladder ranks.</dd>
<dt>Drift control</dt><dd>Records are content-addressed by deterministic generation; the generator validate() function checks every emitted record before it enters the archive.</dd>
<dt>Target</dt><dd>Marching to 1,000,000 records like every database in the network.</dd>
<dt>Signature system</dt><dd>Part of the Signature database network: public data is always real data; Signature-made is real and working inside the Signature ecosystem.</dd>
<dt>Canon compliance</dt><dd>Full canon: archive-aware AI, boundless generator making actual data, full files, maturity honesty on every record, no padding.</dd>
<dt>Ownership</dt><dd>Property of Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).</dd>
<dt>Working version</dt><dd>__WORKING_URL__</dd>
<dt>Last verified</dt><dd>__LAST_VERIFIED__</dd>
<dt>Boundary</dt><dd>Engineering and defensive framing only. No weapon targeting, no attack execution, nothing that helps aim, strike, or defeat military or defense systems.</dd>
<dt>Maturity framework</dt><dd>Every record is labeled existing executable software, validated engineering data, generated prototype, or proposed future capability. "NASA-grade" and "DARPA-grade" describe intended technical ambition, not claims of existing or certified government systems.</dd>
spec_dl:
<dt>Full spec</dt><dd>8 full records per tool class, one per engineering facet: concept and architecture, core algorithms and methods, data models and interfaces, executable demonstration, validation method, maturity assessment, standards and provenance, and the boundless generator blueprint.</dd>
<dt>ID scheme</dt><dd>Deterministic IDs: <prefix><tool-number>-<facet> (e.g. JAH-NDP-000012-concept-architecture). JAH-NDP- = public edition, JAH-NDPS- = Signature edition.</dd>
<dt>Editions</dt><dd>Public edition documents real public engineering methods and systems; Signature edition carries Justin Addam Higgins' original Signature designs, working inside the Signature ecosystem and never presented as public record.</dd>
<dt>Ladder ranks</dt><dd>simple, competitive, mix-and-match, unmade, top-notch-or-better, future-grade, god-mode.</dd>
<dt>Demo verification</dt><dd>Every distinct demonstration program was executed in Node.js during the build and its real output stored in the records.</dd>
<dt>Data URL</dt><dd>https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/jah-databases-data-2/data/nasadarpa-deep-space-navigation-engine-signature/</dd>
<dt>Chunk pattern</dt><dd>data/<slug>/chunks/chunk-0001.jsonl.gz (more chunks as the generator fills the march to a million).</dd>
<dt>Licensing</dt><dd>Public edition: public engineering knowledge with original demo code. Signature edition: original Signature designs, property of Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).</dd>
